name: Elegant Tyrant's Majesty
description: Radiates terrible allure with unholy power and conviction: adds permanent Essence in dice to all Presence, Socialize and Bureaucracy rolls involving one-on-one interaction, and to all intimidation attempts regardless of onlookers. Engenders respect and fear, not likeability.

name: Command the Dead

cost.raw: 5 (mindless) or 10 (ghosts) motes, 1 Willpower, +1/+3 motes per extra target

description: Issues orders to the dead and demands obedience: mindless undead/hungry ghosts cost 5 motes (+1 per extra target); actual ghosts cost 10 motes (+3 per extra target) and require Essence 3+. Roll Manipulation + Presence vs the target's permanent Essence — one success barks simple commands, three compels obedience (ignoring self-harm), five means anything. The walking dead comprehend only simple sentences. May also usurp control from a lower-Essence necromancer.

name: Skeleton Summoning Gesture
description: Channels Essence into the ground; a largely whole nearby skeleton claws its way out at the start of next turn, obeying its maker to the best of its limited intelligence with common-zombie statistics (always extras).

name: Irresistible Succubus Style
description: Heightens her cold beauty to her idealized form, adding permanent Essence to Appearance (a real ideal, not an illusion, immune to glamour/illusion-piercing) and exuding an aura of seduction: any who behold her must roll Temperance or find her overwhelmingly desirable and act to impress her. No effect on higher-Essence beings, the Fair Folk, or those in combat with / believing harm from her.

name: Soul-Flaying Gaze
description: Stares intently at a target within five yards (who must see her eyes) to sap will: roll Manipulation + Presence vs the target's Willpower. Win, and the target is entranced (no action that turn) and loses Essence-worth of Willpower; a character stripped of all Willpower becomes highly suggestible (but cannot be made to harm self/others unless predisposed). Control shatters if the victim takes actual damage.

name: Compelling Whisper Technique
description: Layers speech with a haunting chorus to implant a hidden command: roll Manipulation + Presence vs Willpower; win and he issues one order (task no longer than Essence in turns). The suggestion remains until fulfilled or Manipulation days pass, with no conscious recollection. Cannot make characters harm self/others unless already strongly predisposed.

name: Heart-Stopping Mien
description: Blazes with soul-chilling horror (anima flares as if 15 peripheral motes spent): each turn, anyone attacking her or voluntarily approaching within two yards makes a reflexive Valor roll or suffers unsoakable lethal equal to Essence and loses the action (injuries manifest as heart attacks). Magical beings instead cannot attack her on a failed Valor roll, or do so at a die penalty equal to Essence. Not compatible with the Dusk Caste anima power.
